By definition, the greatest common divisor (GCD) of a set of integers must be an integer that divides each number in the set without leaving a remainder. Since 2683/7 is not an integer, there is no integer that can divide it evenly (as dividing a non-integer by an integer results in a non-integer). 

Therefore, the GCD of a set containing a non-integer number is undefined.
